# LearnPath: Agile Leadership Programme

The Agile Leadership Programme helps team leads guide delivery teams using agile methods. It combines self-paced lessons with coached practice sessions and prepares learners for a recognised industry credential, making it a popular choice for organisations that want a common standard across their leadership group.

## Programme structure

Learners progress through eight modules at their own pace, supported by fortnightly group coaching calls. Each module ends with a short quiz and a practical exercise, such as facilitating a planning session or designing a team working agreement.

FACT: LearnPath includes a certification exam in the course fee.
FACT: LearnPath programme takes 10 weeks to complete on average.
FACT: LearnPath charges 980 dollars per learner.

## Topics

The programme covers agile values and principles, iterative planning, backlog management, coaching conversations, measuring flow, scaling practices across multiple teams and leading through change. Case studies come from software, finance and manufacturing organisations.

## Coaching

Coaching calls are led by certified agile coaches and give learners a chance to discuss challenges they are facing with their own teams. Recordings are available for those who cannot attend live.

## Certification

After completing all modules, learners sit an online proctored exam. Those who pass receive an industry-recognised credential that is valid for two years and can be renewed through continuing education activities. One free resit is included if the first attempt is unsuccessful.

## For organisations

LearnPath offers a dashboard for managers to track learner progress, along with volume pricing for groups of ten or more. Courses can be paid by invoice, and unused seats can be transferred to other employees within twelve months of purchase.
